external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Las Vegas, NV | Audience Acuity has announced they have partnered with CryptoFi to license data from their Super Identity Graph direct to banks and credit unions through a subscription model available within the CryptoFi platform. The partnership provides financial institutions with the ability to license data consisting of rich consumer audiences versus digital profiles that meet the unique characteristics of consumers who demonstrate interest or engagement in cryptocurrency and related topics.
